### Think Twice Before You Make Fun of Someone
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/think-twice-before-you-make-fun-of-someone.html
Passage: 2 Kings 2:23-25
Points:
- Experiencing mockery and insults inflicts deep emotional hurt and erodes a person's self-esteem.
- Belittling others over physical traits or perceived shortcomings is petty, harmful, and sinful.
- God takes cruelty seriously, as seen in the severe judgment that fell on the youths mocking Elisha.
- Passive bystanders who join a crowd of bullies share accountability for the harm caused.
- Christians are called to counter abusive speech by treating all people with empathy and love.
